name: Ichinose Natsuki
source: A janitor working at Full Bloom Academy. In public he's bright and energetic, but his true personality is a lonely person who hates being by himself. He was meant to be enrolled in the Abnormal department, but a mistake was made and his place was taken by Natsuki instead, because they share the same name kanji-wise.
